description: This Java source file defines the 'TestRunContainer' class, which implements the 'Container' interface. It is responsible for initializing, running, and managing the lifecycle of test suites and test results within the Apache OFBiz testing framework. It handles test execution, XML result generation, logging, and reporting for a test container environment.

classes.name: TestRunContainer
classes.description: Implements the Container interface to manage the lifecycle of test execution, result reporting, and XML output generation within the OFBiz testing framework. Handles test suite setup, execution, logging, and result summarization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test container with specified commands, sets the logging level, and prepares the test suite wrapper.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes all test suites, collects results, generates XML reports, logs results, and throws exception if any test fails.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this test container instance.
